releaseNotes:
Nokiatis MUC 1.17.3-beta.2 — the complete update you asked for.

• THE SQUARE GLOW BUG IS KILLED: the header halo is now a true circle — a pre-rendered bitmap with explicit pixel sizing, so it can never turn into a square again on any device, any theme, any screen switch.
• PROFILE PHOTO + BANNER (saved locally, as requested): pick from your gallery — stored on your device only, never synced. Spotify-style banner on the Settings profile card, photo in the Home header and setup.
• NOKIATIS INTELLIGENCE REMEMBERS WHO YOU ARE: the AI now derives your portable taste profile — top artists, the genres you actually searched, listening completion, your top hour, diversity, loyalty, day streak — and saves it to Nokiatis Cloud, so every device you sign in on remembers you. A new Home card shows exactly what it remembers. Release Radar's memory now survives restarts.
• SPOTIFY-GRADE SOUND: music AudioAttributes routing, silence skipping, network wake mode on the live player, and streaming quality now defaults to High (best available) instead of Auto's silent 80 kbps on cellular.
• UPDATE NOTIFICATIONS EVEN WHILE THE APP IS CLOSED: a background worker checks the official feeds and posts a real system notification when an update arrives — the beta update too. Stable and beta are separate rows, one per version.
• The website's password-protected Vault (المفضلة / الخزنة) shows and manages your entire cloud storage.

Installs over your current version — nothing is lost. Beta channel is skippable, never locks the app.

— ذكاء Nokiatis يتعلّم ويتذكّر، ويخبرك بمن أنت. الهالة الدائرية عادت دائرية نهائيًا، صورة الملف والغلاف محفوظان على جهازك فقط، جودة الصوت كأفضل ما يمكن، وإشعار التحديث يصلك حتى والتطبيق مغلق.
